summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around a policy-driven Indonesia nickel chokepoint. The main underfollowed lane is not the well-known Indonesian producers themselves, but US-accessible small/mid-cap assets that could benefit if buyers seek non-Indonesian nickel supply, higher contract optionality, or better trade-flow visibility. This pass keeps weak links as hypotheses/speculation until later filings, contracts, customer exposure, and revenue sensitivity are verified.
